# Land use change and effect on carbon stocks {.unnumbered}

## Desired scenario

### Land use and land cover changes 

From participatory workshop -> transition area of each land cover was decided with participants 

```{r}
rast(c("projections/data/lulc_maps/namria_2025.tif", 
     "projections/data/lulc_maps/desired.tif")) |> 
  setNames(c("namria", "desired")) |>
  as.data.frame(na.rm = TRUE) |>
  count(namria, desired, name = "freq") |>
  mutate(area = freq*30^2*1e-4) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = area, axis1 = namria, axis2 = desired)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = namria), width = 1/12) +
  geom_stratum(width = 1/12, fill = "grey80", color = "black") +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("LULC 2025", "Desired scenario 2056"), expand = c(0.15, 0.05)) +
  labs(
    title = "Alluvial Transition Between current and desired LULC",
    y = "Area (ha)",
    fill = "NAMRIA Class"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

-> spatial distribution of land cover was then obtained with TerrSet by using nearest edge model

```{r}
rast(c("projections/data/lulc_maps/namria_2025.tif", 
     "projections/data/lulc_maps/desired.tif")) |> 
  setNames(c("NAMRIA 2025", "Desired scenario for 2056")) |>
  panel(col = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(10, name = "Paired"))
```
